description: Onboarding flow (RESOLVES design-review Finding 2's onboarding half) and the Home live fasting timer centerpiece. Depends on FEAT-004 (shell, UI primitives, Icon) and FEAT-003/002 (store, recommendation, timer, stages). Grounded in design.md Sections 14, 15 and requirements FR1/FR3.
steps: Create src/features/onboarding/OnboardingFlow.tsx per Section 14: a "use client" component orchestrating stepped cards with a local step index and motion horizontal spring slide. Supports rerun mode via the ?rerun=1 query (calls rerunProfiling and returns to Profile instead of Home).

Create WelcomeStep.tsx (friendly intro -> next), GoalStep.tsx (five Goal options, required, Segmented/stacked cards), ExerciseStep.tsx (Apakah kamu olahraga? ya/tidak; when ya reveal intensity Ringan/Sedang/Berat via motion height animation and require it; when tidak set intensity null; emoji-free copy from copy.ts).

Create RecommendationStep.tsx per Section 14 step 4: call recommendMethod(answers), highlight the recommended method ('Rekomendasi buat kamu') with rationale + warning banner when present, then render the selectable method list. RESOLVE Finding 2: render the onboarding list as METHOD_ORDER.filter(id => id !== 'custom') (custom is NOT selectable in onboarding), plus the 5:2 info card (informational, not selectable). Default selection = recommended method; any listed method tappable; 'Mulai sekarang' confirms.
On confirm call completeOnboarding(answers, selectedMethod) then router.replace('/') (or back to Profile in rerun mode).
Create src/app/onboarding/page.tsx hosting OnboardingFlow; when already onboarded and not in ?rerun=1, redirect to Home.

Flesh out src/app/page.tsx (Home): after hydration, if !onboarded redirect to /onboarding; otherwise render the FastingTimer. Use the hydrated guard so storage-dependent UI does not render before rehydrate (no SSR mismatch).

Create src/features/timer/FastingTimer.tsx per Section 15: reads activeFast from the store; a useTimer 1s interval (only runs when activeFast !== null, cleared on unmount) feeding nowMs into computeTimer; renders ProgressRing, big formatHMS(elapsedMs), formatted targetEndMs, remainingMs, and StageIndicator(stageForElapsed(elapsedMs)). First client render reads now in useEffect/tick to avoid hydration mismatch; stable placeholder before hydration.

Create ProgressRing.tsx (SVG circle with strokeDasharray/strokeDashoffset animated by motion from progress), StageIndicator.tsx (current Stage card with its io5 iconKey + Indonesian description), TimerControls.tsx (Start -> startFast + schedule reminders; Stop -> ConfirmDialog -> stopFast writes session + clears reminders + friendly toast; edit-start-time opens StartTimeSheet), StartTimeSheet.tsx (date+time inputs; validate <= now, block future with inline copy; on save editStartTime recomputes).

Implement auto-complete per Section 15: when isComplete flips true show the no-emoji prompt 'Mantap, target kamu kelar! Mau lanjut atau sudahi?' with Sudahi -> stopFast and Lanjut -> keep counting (overfast toward Deep fast).
acceptance_criteria: `npm run build` completes with zero TypeScript errors and no build-breaking lint.
RecommendationStep renders METHOD_ORDER.filter(id => id !== 'custom') for the onboarding list; custom is not selectable there.

The onboarding flow gates main routes: a first visit (empty storage) shows onboarding before Home, intensity appears only when exercises=ya, and confirming routes to Home with onboarded=true (manual smoke matches AC2/AC3/AC4/AC7).

Started timer shows ticking hh:mm:ss, target end, remaining, and a ring whose fill matches elapsed/target; editing start time to the past recomputes and a future start time is rejected (manual smoke matches AC8/AC9).
Stopping/completing writes a FastingSessionRecord to IndexedDB and clears activeFast.
verification: Run `npm run build` and confirm it exits 0.
Run `npx vitest run src/lib` and confirm all pure-lib suites still pass.
Run `grep -rn "react-icons/" src` and confirm only react-icons/io5; emoji grep over the new feature files returns nothing.
findings: Implemented onboarding (OnboardingFlow + Welcome/Goal/Exercise/Recommendation steps, src/app/onboarding/page.tsx) and the Home live timer (FastingTimer, ProgressRing, StageIndicator, TimerControls, StartTimeSheet, useTimer hook), plus a client-gated src/app/page.tsx. Design-review Finding 2 (onboarding half) RESOLVED: RecommendationStep renders ONBOARDING_METHODS = METHOD_ORDER.filter(id => id !== 'custom'); custom is not selectable in onboarding and 5:2 is an informational-only card. Added copy.timer.* and extra copy.onboarding.* keys to src/lib/copy.ts (emoji-free). Both main-route pages use the store's hydrated guard before any storage-dependent redirect/render; onboarding/page.tsx wraps the useSearchParams flow in Suspense (Next 15 requirement). Timer tick (useTimer) only runs while activeFast !== null, reads the clock inside an effect (null first render -> stable placeholder, no SSR mismatch), feeds computeTimer. Auto-complete prompt uses copy.timer.completeTitle with Lanjut/Sudahi. Verification: `npm run build` exit 0 (only two pre-existing warnings in untouched notifications.ts/recommendation.ts); `npx vitest run src/lib` 140/140 pass; `grep -rn 'react-icons/' src` shows only io5; python emoji scan over new feature files + copy.ts + the two pages returns 0 hits.
